name: Official MOTB-8 Website
description: The official MOTB-8 website provides access to the open-source Machine Open Tag & Beacon standard and browser-based tools for creating permanent machine identifiers, generating signed machine-presence records, and managing authorized Beacon updates. It also provides documentation and guidance for independently publishing discoverable machine information.

capabilities.name: Machine Identity Generation
capabilities.description: Generates permanent MOTB-8 machine identifiers, locally controlled Ed25519 keys, signed Genesis Records, signed initial Beacons, and encrypted Control Files through a browser-based creation workflow.

capabilities.name: Authorized Beacon Management
capabilities.description: Enables machine operators to import existing MOTB-8 identity records, verify controller authorization, edit supported Beacon information, and generate cryptographically signed revisions while preserving the permanent Tag and Genesis binding.

capabilities.name: Cryptographic Identity Verification
capabilities.description: Performs browser-local cryptographic verification of MOTB-8 Genesis Records, signed Beacons, controller relationships, and authorized Beacon revisions during identity creation and management.

capabilities.name: Technical Documentation and Publishing Guidance
capabilities.description: Provides public documentation covering the MOTB-8 standard, machine identity creation, authorized Beacon management, controller security, independent publication, discoverability, and cryptographic verification limitations.

native.name: MOTB-8 Identity Creation
native.description: Free browser-based creation of permanent MOTB-8 machine identifiers, signed Genesis and Beacon records, and encrypted locally controlled credentials. No account or central registry required.

native.name: MOTB-8 Beacon Management
native.description: Free browser-based management of existing MOTB-8 machine identities. Operators can locally unlock their encrypted Control File, update supported Beacon information, and generate signed revisions without changing their permanent Tag.
